verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching threaded replies is a benchmark task named 'reply-to-thread' testing whether an agent's reply lands in the correct thread, implying the platform supports threaded replies, but there is no first-party documentation, UI description, or CLI command explicitly describing thread creation/reply for team-admins or users generally. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/CLI for reply-in-thread UX, screenshots or admin-facing description, and independent corroboration that threading works as a user feature beyond the agent benchmark.
